newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Waigel stresses need for EU tax coordination.
newsitem.headline: Waigel stresses need for EU tax coordination.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel told a meeting of European finance ministers on Monday Bonn strongly wanted coordination of European tax policies to eliminate unfair competition for industry
Weigel's French counterpart, Dominique Strauss-Kahn, said at the same meeting that a code of conduct as proposed by Waigel would not be enough and that binding rules would be necessary.

Waigel, concerned that some of Germany's neighbours are luring capital investment by offering more favourable corporate tax rates, told a meeting of European finance ministers, "We want to have a fairness codex on direct taxes to prevent competition."

A working group of European officials has been discussing coordination of tax policies since January without significant results. The issue is due to be discussed at an informal meeting of European finance ministers in September.
